# PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM] Contents of this Part

## Where to start proceedings

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > Where to start proceedings] 7.1 Restrictions on where proceedings may be started are set out in the relevant practice directions supplementing this Part.

## Claims against Welsh public bodies to be issued and heard in Wales

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > Claims against Welsh public bodies to be issued and heard in Wales] 7.1A Unless required otherwise by any enactment, rule or practice direction, any claim against Welsh public bodies which challenges the lawfulness of their decisions must be issued and heard in Wales.

## Claims against Welsh public bodies to be forwarded for issue in Wales

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > Claims against Welsh public bodies to be forwarded for issue in Wales] 7.1B If a court or centre in England receives a claim which should pursuant to rule 7.1A be issued in Wales a court officer shall forward it for issue in the Administrative Court Office in Wales or other appropriate court office in Wales.”.

## How to start proceedings

## 7.2

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] (1) Proceedings are started when the court issues a claim form at the request of the claimant.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] (2) A claim form is issued on the date entered on the form by the court.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] (A person who seeks a remedy from the court before proceedings are started or in relation to proceedings which are taking place, or will take place, in another jurisdiction must make an application under Part 23)

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] (Part 16 sets out what the claim form must include)

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] (Omitted) (Omitted)

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.2] 7.2A Practice Direction 7A makes provision for procedures to be followed when claims are brought by or against a partnership within the jurisdiction.

## Right to use one claim form to start two or more claims

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > Right to use one claim form to start two or more claims] 7.3 A claimant may use a single claim form to start all claims which can be conveniently disposed of in the same proceedings.

## Particulars of claim

## 7.4

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (1) Particulars of claim must –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (a) be contained in or served with the claim form; or

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (b) subject to paragraph (2) be served on the defendant by the claimant within 14 days after service of the claim form.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (2) Particulars of claim must be served on the defendant no later than the latest time for serving a claim form.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (Rule 7.5 sets out the latest time for serving a claim form)

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (3) Where the claimant serves particulars of claim on the defendant, the claimant must, within 7 days of service on the defendant, file a copy of the particulars unless a copy has already been filed.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.4] (4) The claimant need not file a copy of the particulars of claim under paragraph (3) if the claim is being dealt with at the Production Centre (under rule 7.10) or the Civil National Business Centre (under Practice Direction 7C) and is not transferred to another court.

## Service of a claim form

## 7.5

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.5] (1) Where the claim form is served within the jurisdiction, the claimant must complete the step required by the following table in relation to the particular method of service chosen, before 12.00 midnight on the calendar day four months after the date of issue of the claim form.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.5] (2) Where the claim form is to be served out of the jurisdiction, the claim form must be served in accordance with Section IV of Part 6 within 6 months of the date of issue.

## Extension of time for serving a claim form

## 7.6

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (1) The claimant may apply for an order extending the period for compliance with rule 7.5.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (2) The general rule is that an application to extend the time for compliance with rule 7.5 must be made –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (a) within the period specified by rule 7.5; or

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (b) where an order has been made under this rule, within the period for service specified by that order.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (3) If the claimant applies for an order to extend the time for compliance after the end of the period specified by rule 7.5 or by an order made under this rule, the court may make such an order only if –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (a) the court has failed to serve the claim form; or

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (b) the claimant has taken all reasonable steps to comply with rule 7.5 but has been unable to do so; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (c) in either case, the claimant has acted promptly in making the application.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (4) An application for an order extending the time for compliance with rule 7.5 –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (a) must be supported by evidence; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.6] (b) may be made without notice.

## Application by defendant for service of claim form

## 7.7

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.7] (1) Where a claim form has been issued against a defendant, but has not yet been served on him, the defendant may serve a notice on the claimant requiring him to serve the claim form or discontinue the claim within a period specified in the notice.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.7] (2) The period specified in a notice served under paragraph (1) must be at least 14 days after service of the notice.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.7] (3) If the claimant fails to comply with the notice, the court may, on the application of the defendant –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.7] (a) dismiss the claim; or

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.7] (b) make any other order it thinks just.

## Form for defence etc. must be served with particulars of claim

## 7.8

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (1) When particulars of claim are served on a defendant, whether they are contained in the claim form, served with it or served subsequently, they must be accompanied by –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (a) a form for defending the claim;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (b) a form for admitting the claim; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (c) a form for acknowledging service.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (2) Where the claimant is using the procedure set out in Part 8 (alternative procedure for claims) –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (a) paragraph (1) does not apply; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.8] (b) a form for acknowledging service must accompany the claim form.

## Fixed date and other claims

## 7.9 A practice direction –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.9 A practice direction –] (a) may set out the circumstances in which the court may give a fixed date for a hearing when it issues a claim;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.9 A practice direction –] (b) may list claims in respect of which there is a specific claim form for use and set out the claim form in question; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.9 A practice direction –] (c) may disapply or modify these Rules as appropriate in relation to the claims referred to in paragraphs (a) and (b).

## Production Centre for claims

## 7.10

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (1) There shall be a Production Centre for the issue of claim forms and other related matters.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (2) Practice Direction 7B makes provision for–

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (a) which claimants may use the Production Centre;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (b) the type of claims which the Production Centre may issue;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (c) the functions which are to be discharged by the Production Centre;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (d) the place where the Production Centre is to be located; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (e) other related matters.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.10] (3) Practice Direction 7B may disapply or modify these Rules as appropriate in relation to claims issued by the Production Centre.

## Human Rights

## 7.11

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.11] (1) A claim under section 7(1)(a) of the Human Rights Act 1998 1 in respect of a judicial act may be brought only in the High Court.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.11] (2) Any other claim under section 7(1)(a) of that Act may be brought in any court.

## Electronic issue of claims

## 7.12

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (1) A practice direction may permit or require a claimant to start a claim by requesting the issue of a claim form electronically.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (2) The practice direction may, in particular –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (a) specify –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (i) the types of claim which may be issued electronically; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (ii) the conditions which a claim must meet before it may be issued electronically;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (b) specify –

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (i) the court where the claim will be issued; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (ii) the circumstances in which the claim will be transferred to another court;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (c) provide for the filing of other documents electronically where a claim has been started electronically;

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (d) specify the requirements that must be fulfilled for any document filed electronically; and

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (e) provide how a fee payable on the filing of any document is to be paid where that document is filed electronically.

[PART 7 – HOW TO START PROCEEDINGS – THE CLAIM FORM > 7.12] (3) The practice direction may disapply or modify these Rules as appropriate in relation to claims started electronically.

## Footnotes
